description_en: Queries the X.509 certificate of a device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询设备的X.509证书
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-device-cert --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name light --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value is displayed, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

If no ID value is displayed for the public instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id
